description: D-076 (P-56, partially refutes P-43): gate tiers that reuse a script-test or stage PASS by content (its key: the files it reads, the attested toolchain_id, the judging runner), with gate.content_cache_enabled on. Tier 3 (the battery, the periodic full net) is never listed. gate-tier.cacheable_tiers keeps the box-local carry-over and recorded verdicts to tier 1.
